gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Spaced-out, unshaded lettering from Bushcraft, with capitals that barely rise above the rest. Noto Sans Hebrew follows with a deep midsection and wide gaps at its curve ends, which lets a full page of text move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-hk: Expressive Bushcraft draws each closed letter with one pen tip, spaced generously across the line. Noto Sans HK leaves its curves open instead, lifting brush ends away before they close, a clean counterpoint.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-imperi: Expressive Bushcraft traces every letter as if with one marker, spaced wide and barely lifting its capitals. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic reads approachably, its open-pincer c's keeping paragraphs friendly.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-inscri: Big open eyes mark Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian, with a deep middle band. Bushcraft, on top, has no hairlines at all, its stems matching its curves, so the text below reads smoothly and cleanly.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-jp: Noto Sans JP sweeps its curves open and stretches its lowercase high. Against Bushcraft's blueprint-lettering feel of constant line, that open, sweeping curve is the quality you notice first.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Sturdy lowercase fills the line like capitals, beneath the closed, wide-spaced letters of Bushcraft. Noto Sans Kaithi keeps an open channel in each e, so extended reading moves along without feeling cramped.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-kayah-: No thick-thin swing anywhere in Bushcraft, whose capitals hardly stand out and whose letters sit extra wide apart. Noto Sans Kayah Li lifts its brush ends away before curves close, giving the heading a clean, quiet partner.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-kharos: Expressive sign-painter lettering from Bushcraft, one brush stroke at constant width and spaced well apart. Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, its curves never closing back, which keeps paragraphs approachable.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Artistic Bushcraft spreads its closed, single-stroke letters wide across the line. Noto Sans Khojki counters with wide exits that pass light through and a large eye on every e, a modern, clean foil.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Expressive Bushcraft keeps its stroke widths constant from stem to curve, every letter closed and wide-spaced. Noto Sans Limbu replies with gaping curves and long-bodied small letters, feeling approachable beside it.
